verses.text: Then Job answered,
“Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
lines: “Listen diligently to my speech.
Let this be your consolation.

verses.text: Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
lines: Allow me, and I also will speak;
After I have spoken, mock on.

verses.text: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
lines: As for me, is my complaint to man?
Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

verses.text: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
lines: Look at me, and be astonished.
Lay your hand on your mouth.

verses.text: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
lines: When I remember, I am troubled.
Horror takes hold of my flesh.

verses.text: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?
lines: “Why do the wicked live,
become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

verses.text: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
lines: Their child is established with them in their sight,
their offspring before their eyes.

verses.text: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
lines: Their houses are safe from fear,
neither is the rod of God upon them.

verses.text: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.
lines: Their bulls breed without fail.
Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

verses.text: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
lines: They send out their little ones like a flock.
Their children dance.

verses.text: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
lines: They sing to the tambourine and harp,
and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

verses.text: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.
lines: They spend their days in prosperity.
In an instant they go down to Sheol.

verses.text: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
lines: They tell God, ‘Depart from us,
for we don’t want to know about your ways.

verses.text: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’
lines: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him?
What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

verses.text: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.
lines: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand.
The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.text: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?
lines: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out,
that their calamity comes on them,
that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

verses.text: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?
lines: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind,
as chaff that the storm carries away?

verses.text: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.
lines: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’
Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

verses.text: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
lines: Let his own eyes see his destruction.
Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

verses.text: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?
lines: For what does he care for his house after him,
when the number of his months is cut off?

verses.text: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
lines: “Shall any teach God knowledge,
since he judges those who are high?

verses.text: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
lines: One dies in his full strength,
being wholly at ease and quiet.

verses.text: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
lines: His pails are full of milk.
The marrow of his bones is moistened.

verses.text: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.
lines: Another dies in bitterness of soul,
and never tastes of good.

verses.text: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.
lines: They lie down alike in the dust.
The worm covers them.

verses.text: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
lines: “Behold, I know your thoughts,
the plans with which you would wrong me.

verses.text: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
lines: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince?
Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

verses.text: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
lines: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men?
Don’t you know their evidences,

verses.text: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
lines: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity,
That they are led out to the day of wrath?

verses.text: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?
lines: Who will declare his way to his face?
Who will repay him what he has done?

verses.text: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
lines: Yet he will be borne to the grave.
Men will keep watch over the tomb.

verses.text: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.
lines: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him.
All men will draw after him,
as there were innumerable before him.

verses.text: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
lines: So how can you comfort me with nonsense,
because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
